constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES route_runner_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CHECK (game_id IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID
CHECK (season_id IS NOT NULL AND season_id = (game_id / 1000000 * 10000 + game_id / 1000000 + 1) AND ((game_id / 10000 % 100::bigint) = ANY (ARRAY[2::bigint, 3::bigint]))) NOT VALID
CHECK (home_road IS NULL OR (home_road = ANY (ARRAY['H'::text, 'R'::text]))) NOT VALID
